mapper.select: SELECT l.label_id, l.label_code, l.material_code, l.material_name, l.specification, l.batch_no, l.serial_no, l.manufacturer, l.supplier_name, l.create_time, CASE l.status WHEN 1 THEN '待打包' WHEN 2 THEN '已打包' WHEN 3 THEN '已出库' WHEN 4 THEN '已分发' WHEN 5 THEN '已消耗' WHEN 6 THEN '已退库' ELSE '未知' END as current_status, COALESCE(l.current_location, '中心仓库') as current_location FROM spd_label l WHERE l.label_code = #{labelCode} AND l.del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM ( -- 入库记录（来自验收单） SELECT 1 as operation_type, '入库' as operation_desc, a.acceptance_no as business_no, a.create_user_name as operator_name, a.create_time as operation_time, '供应商' as from_location, '中心仓库' as to_location, a.remark FROM spd_acceptance a INNER JOIN spd_acceptance_detail ad ON a.acceptance_id = ad.acceptance_id WHERE ad.serial_no = #{labelCode} AND a.del_flag = 0
UNION ALL
-- 打包记录 SELECT 2 as operation_type, '打包' as operation_desc, p.package_no as business_no, p.create_user_name as operator_name, p.create_time as operation_time, '中心仓库' as from_location, '待出库区' as to_location, p.remark FROM spd_package p INNER JOIN spd_package_detail pd ON p.package_id = pd.package_id WHERE pd.label_code = #{labelCode} AND p.del_flag = 0
UNION ALL
-- 出库记录（分发到科室） SELECT 3 as operation_type, '出库分发' as operation_desc, '' as business_no, '' as operator_name, NOW() as operation_time, '中心仓库' as from_location, '科室' as to_location, '出库分发到科室' as remark FROM spd_label WHERE label_code = #{labelCode} AND status >= 3 AND del_flag = 0
UNION ALL
-- 消耗记录 SELECT 5 as operation_type, '消耗' as operation_desc, c.consume_no as business_no, c.consume_user_name as operator_name, c.consume_date as operation_time, c.dept_name as from_location, '已消耗' as to_location, c.remark FROM spd_dept_consume c INNER JOIN spd_dept_consume_detail cd ON c.consume_id = cd.consume_id WHERE cd.serial_no = #{labelCode} AND c.del_flag = 0
UNION ALL
-- 退库记录 SELECT 6 as operation_type, '退库' as operation_desc, r.return_no as business_no, r.create_user_name as operator_name, r.create_time as operation_time, r.dept_name as from_location, '中心仓库' as to_location, r.remark FROM spd_dept_return r INNER JOIN spd_dept_return_detail rd ON r.return_id = rd.return_id WHERE rd.serial_no = #{labelCode} AND r.del_flag = 0
UNION ALL
-- 调拨记录 SELECT 7 as operation_type, '调拨' as operation_desc, al.allocation_no as business_no, al.create_user_name as operator_name, al.create_time as operation_time, al.from_dept_name as from_location, al.to_dept_name as to_location, al.remark FROM spd_dept_allocation al INNER JOIN spd_dept_allocation_detail ald ON al.allocation_id = ald.allocation_id WHERE ald.serial_no = #{labelCode} AND al.del_flag = 0 ) track_data ORDER BY operation_time ASC
